input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，The original repeats the time meaning because both parts refer to a time period. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，The occupation noun needs the full word for a medical doctor in this context. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：别人，Use this form for other people in general when no specific person is being contrasted. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看：看到，Here the meaning is “see,” so the resultative form is needed rather than the verb meaning “look at.” [vocab list]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，Plants take the matching measure word rather than the general measure word. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他不知道：不知道，The same character has already been named in the immediately preceding clause, so use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，Use the demonstrative noun phrase to refer clearly back to the particular plant introduced in the previous sentence. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): ，他看到：，看到，The subject remains the same within this sentence, so zero form is more natural than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 神农三个月走去：神农走了三个月，A duration follows the verb, and the completed three-month journey takes 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到：找到了，Finding the place is a completed event in the narrative, so add 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
11. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 看到：看到了，The seeing event is completed; with this resultative verb, 了 follows the resultative part. [teacher rule: le_placement]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
医生 is required for the occupation meaning here; 上医 is not the intended word.
The intended people are 病人, and changing 别的人 to 别人 does not make that correction.
The context means to see someone, so 看到 is the appropriate verb.
一个植物 is acceptable Chinese, although 一株植物 is a more specific and natural measure-word choice.
他 is an acceptable close-reference pronoun after 神农, even though omission is also possible.
The later place should clearly refer back to the particular plant previously introduced as 一种植物.
The subject remains 神农 within the same sentence, so repeating 他 violates the teacher's zero-reference rule.
The duration belongs after the verb, and the completed three-month walk requires 走了三个月.
Finding the place is a completed narrative event, so 找到 needs sentence-internal 了.
The completed seeing event needs 了 after the resultative complement: 看到了.
